headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.title_en: New signals from the central bank on monetary policy and exchange rates
headlines.summary_en: [New Signals on Monetary Policy and Exchange Rates from the Central Bank] The People's Bank of China released its Q2 2026 China Monetary Policy Implementation Report (the "Report") on August 12, analyzing domestic and external conditions, outlining the main monetary policy approach for the next phase, and discussing hot topics such as monetary policy adjustments in major overseas economies and interest rate control mechanisms. The Report states that in the next phase, the PBOC will fully leverage the effectiveness of existing stock policies, promptly plan and introduce practical incremental policies, and calibrate the intensity, pace, and timing of policy implementation based on domestic and international economic and financial conditions and financial market operations. The Report also proposes promoting diversification of loan pricing benchmarks and guiding financial institutions to enhance their interest rate pricing capabilities.

headlines.title_en: Canada considers accepting some auto tariffs in exchange for reduced US tariffs
headlines.summary_en: According to The Globe and Mail, the Canadian government is considering an auto tariff plan that would accept some U.S. auto tariffs in exchange for the U.S. lowering tariffs on vehicles that meet USMCA standards. The plan includes maintaining an exemption policy, whereby the value of U.S.-produced content in Canadian auto exports would not be included in the tariff calculation. Sources say U.S.-Canada negotiators have discussed the plan. Under preliminary details, Trump's auto tariffs, imposed under Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962, could be further reduced from the current 25% levied on all Canadian auto exports meeting USMCA standards. Additionally, the value of U.S. components in Canadian-made vehicles would remain excluded from tariff calculations. headlines.title: 利好来了！7月份美国核心通胀表现温和 美联储加息预期骤减
headlines.summary: 【利好来了！7月份美国核心通胀表现温和 美联储加息预期骤减】8月12日晚间，美国劳工统计局公布的数据显示，剔除通常波动较大的食品和能源类别，核心消费者价格指数（CPI）环比上涨0.2%。按年率计算，该指数上涨2.5%，与2021年3月以来的最慢增速持平。在美国通胀数据表现温和后，市场目前定价显示，9月加息概率约为50%。利率互换市场显示，在经济数据公布后，交易员将10月加息预期从一天前的约75%下调至约60%。市场目前已完全定价美联储下一次政策调整将在12月发生。

headlines.title_en: Good news! US core inflation is mild in July, Fed rate hike expectations plummet
headlines.summary_en: [Good News! U.S. Core Inflation Was Moderate in July, Rate Hike Expectations Drop Sharply] On the evening of August 12, data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics showed that the core consumer price index (CPI), excluding the usually volatile food and energy categories, rose 0.2% month over month. On an annual basis, the index rose 2.5%, matching the slowest pace since March 2021. After the moderate U.S. inflation data, market pricing currently shows about a 50% probability of a rate hike in September. Interest rate swap markets show that traders cut the odds of an October rate hike to about 60%, down from about 75% a day earlier, after the data release. The market has now fully priced in the Fed's next policy move occurring in December.
